proposed_ledger_entry: Item 320 proves an all-prefix complement-resonance theorem conditional on the exact Item-316 target. The top complement c-|E| is exactly Item-295's t_n and has a previous-scale canonical leading digit 2 for n=5..8 and 3 for n>=9. Prefix determinants obey an exact forced continuant recurrence. For every rational lambda<1/2 and every sufficiently large n with the explicit threshold N_lambda, all truncations through depth floor(lambda n) have both their signed prefix error and complement farther than every allowed digit from the endpoints. Their appended dual errors therefore miss every exact earlier Item-316 target by a strictly positive carry-aware gap. The continuous gap center is a normalized Casoratian, but this is in the reverse real-center orientation and yields no Item-282 de-overlapped overlap. The theorem closes only literal prefix/complement target-inheritance descent below half-linear depth. The exact all-digit exclusion, lambda>=1/2/full-depth descent, centered half-bound, proper targets, and every beta capacity consequence remain open. Booking is zero.
